due_when.clears_when: An automated breakout_1 close lands in prop_fills (source prop_executor) with exit_price, pnl and a reason naming tp / sl / manual read from the terminal's Trade History, NOT 'closed_on_terminal (... exit read from the terminal history is not built)'. The first test case is the close of prop-manual-d27fbb0b2b25 (ETHUSDT short opened 2026-10-02 18:50Z). Killed only if the operator decides prop exits are graded from another source, named in the terminal_reason.

what: The breakout_1 executor cannot record HOW an automated position closed. _reconcile_journal reports a journal-open position that is absent from the terminal for 2 reads as status 'closed' with reason 'closed_on_terminal (executor reconcile; exit read from the terminal history is not built)', with no exit_price, no pnl and no TP/SL reason. Now live: the first automated strategy trade (prop-manual-d27fbb0b2b25, ETHUSDT short, open since 18:54Z 2026-10-02, bracket SL 2718.46 / TP 2394.06) will close this way, and so will every one after it, so prop closes land ungraded with a close reason that is not TP/SL. Fix: a read-only DXtrade Trade History reader and an executor close report carrying exit price, realised P&L and the tp/sl/manual reason, HELD Tier-2.
